target.title: chore: address gollaw code health audit findings (#293)
target.body:
## Overview

Refactor to address code health findings from [gollaw](https://github.com/dovocoder/gollaw) static analysis. Closes #293.

## Problem

Gollaw v0.2.0-dev identified **762 findings** (health score 0/100, grade F). The most actionable categories were code duplication (89 findings from repeated mutex-guard patterns) and large functions (83 findings with functions exceeding 50 lines).

## Changes

### Extract `lockedClient`/`connectedClient` helpers (`internal/wa/`)

The `c.mu.Lock(); cli := c.client; c.mu.Unlock(); if cli == nil ...` guard pattern was repeated 46+ times across `client.go`, `groups.go`, `newsletters.go`, `appstate.go`, and `media.go`. Extracted two helpers:

```go
func (c *Client) lockedClient() *whatsmeow.Client  // nil if not initialized
func (c *Client) connectedClient() (*whatsmeow.Client, error)  // error if not connected
```

Each call site went from 6 lines to 3 lines. **Eliminated 46 duplication findings** (89→43).

### Refactor large functions

| Function | Before | After | Extraction |
|----------|-------:|------:|------------|
| `BackfillHistory` | 190 lines | 88 lines | On-demand handler + request loop |
| `storeParsedMessage` | 169 lines | 67 lines | Contact/group/media/upsert helpers |
| `extractBusinessText` | 144 lines | <50 lines | Template/buttons/list message handlers |
| `sendFile` | 159 lines | 71 lines | Media type/proto/persistence helpers |

## Impact

| Metric | Before | After | Δ |
|--------|-------:|------:|---:|
| Total findings | 762 | 716 | **−46** |
| Duplication | 89 | 43 | **−46** |
| Complexity | 35 | 34 | −1 |
| Hotspots | 14 | 12 | −2 |
| Health score | 0/100 (F) | 0/100 (F) | — |

The health score remains 0/F because deadcode (372, mostly cobra dispatch false positives) and large-functions (83, mostly CLI command constructors) still dominate. These require different approaches (analyzer improvements for cobra, deeper refactoring of command constructors).

## Testing

Full gate passes:
- `pnpm format:check` ✓
- `pnpm lint` (go vet) ✓
- `pnpm test` (go test + FTS5 tests) ✓
- `pnpm build` (sqlite_fts5) ✓
- `git diff --check` ✓

No behavior changes — pure refactoring. All public APIs unchanged.
